mager.label: Isolated mager
mager.description: One mager at range; its first attack is on the next tick.

bat.label: Isolated bat
bat.description: One bat in attack range, with a three-tick attack cycle.

blob.label: Blob read
blob.description: One blob at range, ready to read your prayer on the next tick.

blob-flinch.label: Blob behind the pillar
blob-flinch.description: One blob with a Magic attack pending in three ticks. You are already behind the north pillar.

ranger-blob.label: Ranger and blob
ranger-blob.description: A ranger and blob can both see you. The ranger attacks and the blob reads on the next tick.

mager-blob.label: Mager and blob
mager-blob.description: A mager and blob at range, with their first attack and read on the next tick.

two-blobs.label: Mager and two blobs
two-blobs.description: A mager and two visible blobs. Their initial reads are one tick apart.

corner.label: Bat at the pillar
corner.description: A bat is trapped west of the north pillar; you start on the east side.

melee-dig.label: Mager and trapped melee
melee-dig.description: A visible mager and a trapped melee. The melee is set to check for a dig in three ticks for this exercise.

pillar-stack.label: Ranger–mager pillar stack
pillar-stack.description: A front ranger and back mager east of the north pillar; you start at the middle of its west face.

weapon-range.label: Weapon range and exposure
weapon-range.description: A visible ranger is nine tiles away; a blob is hidden by the north pillar.

bloblets.label: Three bloblets
bloblets.description: The Magic, Ranged and Melee bloblets are already placed east of the north pillar.

late-opening.label: Late-wave exposure
late-opening.description: A fixed practice layout with a mager, ranger, melee, blob and a nibbler beside the south pillar.

collision.label: Same-tick ranger and mager
collision.description: Both enemies can see you and will attack on the next tick.

two-tick-movement.label: Two-tick movement and a hidden blob
two-tick-movement.description: A mager and one blob are visible. A second blob waits beyond the north pillar.

two-tick-stack.label: Two-tick attack offset
two-tick-stack.description: A mager attacks on tick 1 and a ranger on tick 3; both repeat every four ticks.

reverse.label: Mager and bat
reverse.description: A four-tick mager and three-tick bat. Their first attacks coincide; some attacks cannot both be protected.

melee-blob.label: Melee and blob
melee-blob.description: An adjacent melee and an at-range blob. This is a mitigation setup, with some blob exposure.

two-tick-repair.label: Misaligned two-tick blob
two-tick-repair.description: A mager attacks on tick 1; the blob first reads on tick 2. Compare the two two-tick holds.
